_meta.title: Session 33 — Claude Opus 4.8 System Card + AutoScientists + SkillOpt (4 links)
_meta.context: User-provided 4 links. (1) Claude Opus 4.8 System Card (244pp, Anthropic, May 28 2026) — new flagship, superior to Opus 4.7 across nearly all evals, weaker than Mythos Preview overall. Full capability suite (Section 8) + cyber (Section 3.3) ingested. Headline: SWE-Verified 88.6, SWE-Pro 69.2, USAMO 2026 96.7 (vs 4.7 69.3), GDPval-AA 1890 ELO (+121 over GPT-5.5 = 66.7% winrate), Online-Mind2Web 84, GraphWalks 1M BFS 68.1 (vs 4.7 40.3). Fast mode $10/$50 per M tok (3x cheaper). (2) AutoScientists (arxiv 2605.28655, Harvard — Gao/Fang/Zitnik): decentralized self-organizing agent teams for long-running science. BioML-Bench 74.40% mean percentile (vs Autoresearch 66.07), drug-discovery 46.16->64.52, ProteinGym full 217-assay Spearman 0.657->0.700, ACE2-Spike 0.747->0.840 (+12.5%), GPT nanochat bpb 0.9730 (7 vs 0 improvements over Autoresearch). (3) SkillOpt (arxiv 2605.23904, Microsoft+SJTU+Tongji+Fudan): controllable text-space optimizer for agent skills. Best/tied on all 52 (model,bench,harness) cells. On GPT-5.5: +23.5 direct chat / +24.8 Codex / +19.1 Claude Code no-skill uplift.
_meta.rule: STRICT-ATTRIBUTION. All Opus 4.8 scores verbatim from System Card Section 8 (Table 8.1.A capability summary + per-section detail) + Section 3.3 (cyber). For EXISTING benchmark IDs where the card's Opus 4.7 value matches DB (swe_bench_verified/pro/multilingual, gpqa_diamond, hle no-tools, gdpval_aa, browsecomp, deepsearchqa, finance_agent_v2, vending_bench_2), only Opus 4.8 added — existing comparison rows untouched. For benchmarks where card methodology differs from DB (cybergym 24.5 vs 73.1, firefox_147 45.2 vs 1.2, terminal-bench 2.0 vs 2.1), NEW unambiguous IDs created to avoid clobbering. Comparison-model scores added only on NEW benchmark IDs. Mythos Preview = anthropic/claude-mythos-preview. AutoScientists/SkillOpt baselines (Autoresearch/Kermut) noted in-line, not registered as orphan models.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.8
models._note: Anthropic flagship, upgrade on Opus 4.7. Superior across nearly all evals; weaker than Mythos Preview overall. Defaults to high effort. ~4x less likely than 4.7 to allow code flaws. $5/$25 per M tok regular, $10/$50 fast mode (3x cheaper). Text-only output, multilingual, up to 1M context.

models.name: AutoScientists
models._note: Decentralized self-organizing agent teams for long-running computational science (Gao/Fang/Zitnik, arxiv 2605.28655). No central orchestrator — agents form teams dynamically around hypotheses on a shared state, critique proposals before spending compute, share failures. Spans biomedical imaging / drug discovery / single-cell omics / protein engineering / LM training optimization. Code: github.com/mims-harvard/AutoScientists.

models.name: SkillOpt
models._note: First systematic controllable text-space optimizer for agent skills (Microsoft+SJTU+Tongji+Fudan, arxiv 2605.23904). A separate optimizer model turns scored rollouts into bounded add/delete/replace edits on a single skill doc; an edit is accepted only if it strictly improves a held-out validation score. Textual learning-rate budget + rejected-edit buffer + epoch-wise slow/meta update. Zero inference-time model calls at deployment. Best/tied on all 52 (model,bench,harness) cells across 6 benches / 7 models / 3 harnesses.
